overview: Dr. Qiang Ding is an Professor of Department of Anesthesiology & Perioperative Medicine, Division of Molecular and Translational Biomedicine, University of Alabama at Birmingham. Dr. Ding received his PhD degree in molecular and cellular pathology at the University of Alabama at Birmingham. After completing his postdoctoral fellowship training in the UAB Department of Pathology. Dr. Ding is actively involved in education, research, training, and service for the community. He holds a secondary appointment in the Department of Cell, Developmental, and Integrative Biology (CDIB), is a member of the Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities Research Center (IDDRC), and is a faculty member of the Graduate Biomedical Science PhD program at the University of Alabama at Birmingham.
